Balance: On: 3 power and 10 credits per card, no material (original behaviour). Off: normal mode, 1 unit of 3D Printing Filament per card plus 6 power and 10 credits. Normal mode adds a filament slot; changing this needs a reload because the machine window is built when the printer is created.
Presses out blank access cards. Easy mode needs a battery, 3 power and 10 credits per card. Normal mode also uses 1 unit of 3D Printing Filament per card.
